text: とししたに　まけるの　だけは　いや　だったのに！

structure.jp: とししたに　まけるの　だけは
structure.en: losing to someone younger, that alone

patterns.name: 〜のに
patterns.explanation: のに at the end means 'even though', said with regret because things turned out the opposite way. いや　だったのに = 'and I so didn't want that!'

patterns.name: 〜の (nominalizer)
patterns.explanation: の after a verb turns the action into a thing you can talk about, like '-ing' in English. まけるの = 'losing'.

patterns.name: 〜だけは
patterns.explanation: だけは singles out one thing above all others: 'that at least, if nothing else'. まけるの　だけは = 'losing, of all things'.
